title: get_resume_templates_should_return_list_of_templates
description: Test GET /api/resume/templates to verify it returns a 200 status with a list of available resume templates including thumbnails and configuration details.

title: upload_resume_file_should_parse_and_create_resume
description: Test POST /api/resume/upload with a valid resume file to ensure it returns 200 with parsed resume data, followed by POST /api/resume to create a new resume record and receive 200 with the created resume data.

title: upload_corrupted_resume_file_should_return_extraction_error
description: Test POST /api/resume/upload with a corrupted or malformed file to verify it returns a 400 status with an extraction error message.

title: get_resume_by_valid_id_should_return_resume_data
description: Test GET /api/resume/{id} with a valid existing resume ID to ensure it returns 200 with the corresponding ResumeDataModel.

title: get_resume_by_nonexistent_id_should_return_404
description: Test GET /api/resume/{id} with a non-existent resume ID to verify it returns a 404 status with a 'Resume not found' error.

title: update_existing_resume_should_return_updated_data
description: Test PUT /api/resume/{id} with updated ResumeDataModel and an existing resume ID to ensure it returns 200 with the updated resume data.

title: update_nonexistent_resume_should_return_404
description: Test PUT /api/resume/{id} with updated ResumeDataModel and a non-existent resume ID to verify it returns 404 with a 'Resume not found' error.

title: delete_existing_resume_should_return_ok
description: Test DELETE /api/resume/{id} with an existing resume ID to ensure it returns 200 OK indicating successful deletion.

title: delete_nonexistent_resume_should_return_404
description: Test DELETE /api/resume/{id} with a non-existent resume ID to verify it returns 404 with a 'Resume not found' error.

title: post_api_ai_enhance_should_return_enhanced_text
description: Test POST /api/ai/enhance with a valid AIRequestModel containing resume_id, section, and text to verify it returns 200 with enhanced text in AIResponseModel.
